searchText: Why is there any questions about this, I think the exponential fee like 8282 should be more than fine, we want to really throttle on runs (which voluntary exits can trigger) but at the same time we can't do much cause withdrawals are already in place. So I really think we just need to copy the builder deposit contract fee mechanism and that's it <@565595741477928990> The problem with this check ``` if get_pending_balance_to_withdraw(state, index) != 0: return ``` I think it was originally about fear that the withdrawal would be double minted. I think we can more or less easily go around that by checking at the time of fullfilling the withdrawals. The typical issue is of course edge cases because this withdrawal needs to be informed to the engine before the proposal, and it needs to be fullfilled async between burning on the CL and miting on the EL in a later stage in the slot. This requires a sync mechanism at 3 stages and people just wanted simplicity. I think the issue you raise indeed warrants at least analizing if all these edge cases can be formally solved and just get rid of this. I think it should be fine to just check for balances before burning on the CL and passing payload attributes.

excerpts.content:
<@565595741477928990> The problem with this check 
```
if get_pending_balance_to_withdraw(state, index) != 0:
    return
``` 
I think it was originally about fear that the withdrawal would be double minted. I think we can more or less easily go around that by checking at the time of fullfilling the withdrawals. The typical issue is of course edge cases because this withdrawal needs to be informed to the engine before the proposal, and it needs to be fullfilled async between burning on the CL and miting on the EL in a later stage in the slot. This requires a sync mechanism at 3 stages and people just wanted simplicity. I think the issue you raise indeed warrants at least analizing if all these edge cases can be formally solved and just get rid of this. I think it should be fine to just check for balances before burning on the CL and passing payload attributes.
